name: BEng (Engineering)
notes: 2027 booklet: NSC aggregate 70% (excluding LO); selection uses a separate selection mark (Math + Phys + 6×average). English rules vary for FAL/Afrikaans combinations — see prospectus.

name: BSc (Science)
notes: Representative 2027 biological-stream minima; many streams need Mathematics 70% and/or Chemistry. Afrikaans or English may satisfy language — see Faculty of Science. Selection uses a weighted selection mark.

name: BSc (Computer Science)
notes: 2027: aggregate 65%; Mathematics 70%; Physical Sciences 50% if Chemistry or Physics taken at university.

name: BCom (Management / Economic Sciences)
notes: 2027: BCom (Management Sciences) and BCom (Economic Sciences) use aggregate 65% and language rules involving Afrikaans/English — see booklet. Some focal areas need higher Mathematics.

name: BAcc (Accounting)
notes: 2027: Mathematics 70% OR (Mathematics 60% with Accounting 70%); aggregate 70%; English/Afrikaans rules in prospectus.

name: LLB
notes: 2027 four-year LLB: aggregate 70%; English or Afrikaans HL 60% OR FAL 70%; NBT AQL before 31 July.

name: BA (Arts & Social Sciences)
notes: Many BA programmes require higher aggregates (e.g. 63–65%) — this row is a softer planning baseline; confirm your programme on maties.com.

name: BEd
notes: 2027 Education faculty: aggregate 60% (excluding LO); additional language rules for Afrikaans/isiXhosa apply — see booklet.

name: Health Sciences (MBChB-oriented)
notes: 2027 MBChB: aggregate 75% (excluding LO). Other health programmes use 60% aggregate with different subject mixes — see Faculty of Medicine and Health Sciences.

name: Agriculture (AgriSciences)
notes: Representative 2027 AgriSciences degree minima (e.g. BAgric Agribusiness); other Agri programmes differ — see booklet.

name: BSc (Mathematics)
notes: 2027 BSc Mathematical Sciences stream; Physical Sciences 50% if Physics or Chemistry taken at university.

name: Built Environment (planning baseline)
notes: Use programme-specific requirements for non-engineering built-environment degrees; many BSc/EMS streams use aggregate 65% with Maths/Science minima.

name: BCom (Economic Sciences)
notes: 2027 booklet: aggregate 65%; see language and focal-area Mathematics rules (e.g. 70% for some electives).

name: Bachelor of Data Science (BDatSci)
notes: 2027: aggregate 80%; stricter Afrikaans/English rules in prospectus for this interfaculty programme.
